issues: Flat light-grey background with a small grey line icon; the frame was empty and looked like an icon-set screenshot, not a brand ending
The flip was a 2D scaleX squash with no perspective, and nothing happened at the thinnest moment to sell the transformation
The flower mark was five flat ellipses in a starfish shape: single layer, no brand feel
The wordmark used a real brand name, and the frame went completely still after it landed
changes: Custom 'conservatory' look: a near-black green stage with a pale mint top light, an apricot floor pool and dust; the only accent is the coral-to-apricot petals, and the brand is now a fictional AI answer product, Pollen
The hero is a 300px ivory app icon with a dark green smiling-laptop glyph and a contact shadow; the anticipation is three tilts of growing size, with the shadow following

The flip is a true 3D rotateY 0 to 90 degrees in perspective (t-cubed acceleration) with two lagging ghosts; on the edge-on frame an ivory line and vertical flare light up, the shot's only light effect

The bloom has two layers of five teardrop SVG petals (coral roots, apricot tips, a ridge highlight); the closed state alternates up and down to form that exact line, the outer ring springs open and the inner ring follows 4f later, offset 36 degrees

The mark steps aside (position first, scale 3f later), 'Pollen' at 200px lands letter by letter with scale and blur, and the tagline rises word by word; after landing the petals turn very slowly and the camera pushes in 2.5%; 130f to 150f
